scenario: Rule-wide ("global") cooldown / debounce suppression is deferred per LCDB.7.2 — the v1 grammar carries no `global` modifier; per-activation-key (LCDB.7.1) is the only mode. Pinned via grammar-acceptance: a rule with `cooldown 5_min` and no `global` modifier compiles cleanly (the only mode v1 offers).
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r cooldown 5_min:
    Trig
->
    log info "x"
